classification.spec_type_rationale: KVTable is net-new code — 0 internal implementations of the key-value-editor capability; scaffolds a new organisms/request/ component + lib/ validVars selector, reusing the existing tabsStore/tokens.css substrate (discover 2026-07-04).

spec_seeds.overview: Build KVTable, a hand-rolled controlled key-value grid that edits the active request tab's RequestSpec params[] and headers[] (both Row[] of {enabled,key,value,description}). A single reusable component is instanced twice — once bound to params, once to headers — via a 'params'|'headers' field prop. It renders an enabled checkbox, key/value/description mono cells, a hover-revealed delete affordance, and an auto-promoting trailing empty row, and highlights {{variable}} tokens in the key and value cells, flagging unknown ones against the active environment. It reads and writes exclusively through the existing tabsStore.updateActiveSpec action (no local copy), matches design/styles.css to pixel fidelity, and ships built + component-tested in isolation — it is NOT mounted into the running app (the parent pane-tabs container is a separate task). Autocomplete on the value field and any {{variable}} RESOLUTION are out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The KVTable component shall exist as a single-file component with a sibling token-bound stylesheet under the organisms request directory.
The renderer shall provide a pure variable-tokeniser module under the lib directory.
The renderer shall provide an environment validVars selector module under the lib directory.
The build shall introduce no new table, combobox, or autocomplete runtime dependency.
WHILE KVTable is not mounted into the application shell this feature, the running application behavior shall remain unchanged.

WHEN KVTable writes an edited array via updateActiveSpec with a fresh array reference, the tabsStore shall flip the active tab dirty flag through its existing no-op-guarded merge without modification to the store.
The KVTable feature shall add no new tabsStore action and shall not modify the tabsStore or requestSpec modules.
WHEN the user types text into the key or value cell of the trailing empty row, KVTable shall append a real row and render a fresh trailing empty row.
The KVTable tokeniser shall match the shortest non-greedy delimited token and shall treat an empty token or an unclosed opener as plain text.
The KVTable component shall be authored once and instanced twice through a field prop selecting params or headers.
The KVTable component shall highlight variable tokens in the key and value cells only and not in the description cell.
The KVTable component shall not resolve or substitute variable values and shall render all cell text verbatim.
WHEN a row is deleted or the trailing empty row auto-promotes, KVTable shall keep focus on an adjacent cell and shall never move focus to the document body.
The KVTable row enabled toggle shall be a real checkbox input and the row delete control shall be a real button element.
WHEN the user edits any cell, the KVTable component shall write a new row array for the bound field through updateActiveSpec.
WHILE a row enabled toggle is off, the KVTable component shall render that row with the disabled styling and an unchecked checkbox.
WHEN the user toggles a row checkbox, the KVTable component shall flip that row enabled flag and write the change through updateActiveSpec.
WHEN the user activates a real row delete control, the KVTable component shall remove that row through updateActiveSpec and move focus to an adjacent row.
WHILE the active validVars set is non-empty, the KVTable component shall mark a variable token absent from validVars as a missing-variable token and a present one as a known token.
WHILE the active validVars set is empty, the KVTable component shall render every variable token as a neutral token and mark none as missing.
WHEN the bound array is replaced externally, the KVTable component shall re-render from the new array and shall not retain stale local edits.
WHERE a variable token name contains dots dashes or unicode characters, the KVTable component shall compare its trimmed name verbatim against validVars without a word-character restriction.
WHEN the user pastes multi-line text into a cell, the KVTable component shall collapse the newlines to spaces and shall not create additional rows.
IF a rapid or large paste enters the trailing empty row, THEN the KVTable component shall spawn exactly one new trailing empty row.
WHEN the user presses Tab within a row, the KVTable component shall move focus from checkbox to key to value to description and then onward to the next row.
IF the user toggles the checkbox or edits the description of an otherwise-empty trailing row, THEN the KVTable component shall not promote that row to a real row.
The exported KVTable props the varTokens tokeniser and the envVars selector shall each carry documentation comments.
The renderer source shall pass strict web type-checking.
The codebase shall pass ESLint without new errors.
The project shall build cleanly.
The new KVTable source shall contain no inline style attributes.
The new renderer modules shall not import electron or node built-in modules directly.
The KVTable component and lib unit suites shall pass.
acceptance_criteria.verification_command: npx playwright test src/renderer/src/components/organisms/request/__tests__/KVTable.ct.tsx && npx vitest run src/renderer/src/lib/__tests__/varTokens.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/__tests__/envVars.test.ts

ac_subsection_na.ci_pipeline: No CI pipeline changes; tests run via existing npm scripts (vitest/playwright), not a new pipeline stage.
ac_subsection_na.hooks_gates: No new git hooks or commit gates; the project's existing forge gates apply unchanged.

constraints.content: requestSpec is a pure data module imported by tabsStore, never by components — KVTable obtains the Row type via a type-only import, never a value import.
Domain invariant: requestSpec stays a pure data module (imported by tabsStore, never by components); KVTable must not value-import it.
Strict mode, no implicit any — the tokeniser, Row[] transforms, and the params-or-headers field-prop union are fully typed; untyped boundaries narrow rather than cast.
Naming: KVTable.tsx PascalCase one-per-file + sibling KVTable.css; the lib helpers varTokens/envVars are camelCase modules; tests co-located under __tests__ split .test.tsx/.ct.tsx.
Renderer-only: no Node or electron imports in KVTable, varTokens, or envVars.
Resolve cross-module imports via the @renderer alias, not deep relative paths; lib/ must not import components/.
Boundary lookups degrade gracefully — the validVars selector returns ∅ (never throws) when the env store is absent, and KVTable renders neutral tokens rather than flagging everything missing.

Reproduce design/reference.html via semantic classes bound to tokens.css; never use inline styles (constitution §4 Never Do) and never import the design-export cruft (data-om-* attrs, __OmT wrappers, inline styles, tweaks-panel). Take exact resolved values from design/styles.css (.kv block), NOT tokens.json (reference-only, can drift).
RequestSpec must stay a plain JSON-serializable object (feature 004 Q-2) — KVTable writes plain Row objects only (no class instances, Symbols, or functions on the data shape).

Pixel fidelity to design/styles.css .kv block (0px deviation; treat var(--token) as resolves-to-token, not literal hex), verified by computed-style CT assertions: grid-template-columns 22px 1fr 1fr 1fr 24px; .kv-header height 30px, font 10.5px uppercase letter-spacing 0.04em color var(--text-faint) weight 600; .kv-row min-height 32px border-bottom var(--border-faint) color var(--text); checkbox 12px accent-color var(--accent); .kv-cell padding 6px 10px mono font 12px; .kv-cell.value color var(--text-muted); .var color var(--accent); .var.missing color var(--m-delete) + line-through dotted; .kv-actions display none then flex on :hover; .kv-row.disabled opacity 0.55.

affected_areas.impact: Create new — the controlled key-value grid (Option A) + its sibling token-bound stylesheet; takes a field:'params'|'headers' prop, instanced twice.
Create new — pure non-greedy {{...}} tokeniser (empty/unclosed = plain text; unicode/dot/dash keys) returning token spans for display-only highlighting; unit-testable in isolation.
Create new — thin ∅-defaulting selector returning the active environment's validVars set; returns ∅ until env store T14 lands (stable seam).
Create new — Playwright CT (mock Row[] fixtures) for grid behaviour + fidelity computed-style asserts; Vitest unit suites for the tokeniser edge rules and the ∅-default selector.
No change — KVTable reads active-tab Row[] via a per-field selector and writes via the existing updateActiveSpec action; no new store action added.
No change — KVTable does a type-only import of Row (honors §5.2: requestSpec never value-imported by components).
No change — KVTable.css binds semantic .kv classes to existing token custom properties; resolved fidelity values sourced from design/styles.css .kv block.

out_of_scope.content: Variable RESOLUTION / {{...}} substitution — highlighting is display-only; resolving or substituting variable values stays out of scope (continues feature 004 §6 no-interpolation deferral).
Value-field {{variable}} autocomplete — deferred to its own post-T14 follow-up task that runs the Radix/Downshift/React-Aria build-vs-buy; v1 ships highlight + missing-flag only.
The environment model / validVars store (task T14) — consumed via the thin ∅-defaulting selector, NOT built here.

The parent pane-tabs container (RequestSubTabs / Params-Auth-Headers-Body-Tests-Code strip) — a separate task; KVTable ships independently-mountable and is NOT wired into the running app this feature.
Row reorder / drag handle and bulk enable-disable / select-all — no design surface in the reference; deferred.

Multi-line / expandable value cells, per-row content-type or file-upload values, value masking / secret-hiding, bulk multi-line paste-to-rows, and header/param NAME validation (wire-level validity is the http-engine T10 concern).
The import-from-cURL parse path itself — lives with RequestBar / command-palette; KVTable only renders + edits the arrays correctly when populated externally.

open_questions.content: The exact {{variable}} autocomplete combobox composition (reuse the adopted Radix Popover + which headless hook — Downshift useCombobox vs React-Aria useComboBox) is deferred to the post-T14 autocomplete follow-up task; it is data-starved until the env store lands and out of scope here.

risks.risk: Fidelity drift (px, weight, color, letter-spacing) slips past static CSS-vs-styles.css review — the memory lesson is that only runtime getComputedStyle catches it.
risks.mitigation: Add a computed-style CT assertion locking every pinned .kv value across states (default/disabled/hover/var/var-missing); run the runtime design-auditor against the live component; do NOT trust a green static pass.

risks.risk: Controlled-input focus/caret management: writing through the store on every keystroke re-renders and can jump the caret or drop focus on auto-promote or delete.
risks.mitigation: Spike Option A in isolation first; use stable React keys per row; pin 'focus never lost on auto-promote/delete' + Tab traversal order as required CT scenarios.

risks.risk: External-array mutation (import-from-cURL replacing params/headers while a cell is focused) resurrects stale edits or crashes the render.
risks.mitigation: Option A holds no local copy — derive rows from the store each render; add a CT that replaces the bound array mid-edit and asserts a clean reactive re-render.

risks.risk: The validVars ∅-default degradation mis-fires — every {{token}} rendered as missing on a project with no environment.
risks.mitigation: Explicit CT: validVars ∅ → all tokens neutral .var, zero .var.missing; the selector returns ∅ (never undefined/throw) when the env store is absent.

risks.risk: CT fidelity fixture omits the full styling context (tokens.css import, box-sizing, className scope), producing false pass/fail.
risks.mitigation: Reproduce the full styling context in the fixture (import tokens.css, scope box-sizing:border-box inline, wrap in the production className) per the CT-fixture-scoping memory lesson; do not global-import base.css.

risks.risk: Long CT runs stall an /implement subagent at the 600s watchdog.
risks.mitigation: Run npm run test:ct in the main thread (background bash), apply edits inline, then re-fan the no-tools review panel (implement-CT-watchdog memory lesson).
